gridlessCombat.name: Gridless Combat
gridlessCombat.hint: Enable continuous combat geometry, automatic cover, area targeting, and movement overlays on gridless PF2e and SF2e scenes. Includes flanking and attack-distance guides. Requires reload.

movementPreview.name: Movement Preview
movementPreview.hint: Remaining-movement overlay style on gridless scenes. Off hides the overlay; Simple circle draws the remaining distance as a plain circle (routed path costs included, terrain ignored); Reachable ring outlines the approximate reachable area. Applies to the next preview.

movementDebug.name: Movement Debug
movementDebug.hint: Show reachable cells for one selected token on the hex lattice. Terrain colours fill cells at low opacity. Outlines show this token's cost: white normal, amber higher, red triple or more. Aquatic requires an Environment region tag. Local to this client.

enforceClimb.name: Refuse climbs on foot
enforceClimb.hint: Off by default: a move up a ledge of more than one 2.5 ft tread goes ahead, takes the new height and prompts the Climb roll. When enabled, a walking-type move is refused at the ledge and Climb, Fly, Blink or Displace are needed.

promptMovementChecks.name: Prompt checks for ledges and gaps
promptMovementChecks.hint: When a move climbs or drops more than one 2.5 ft tread, post the system's Climb (Athletics) roll; when it squeezes through a tight gap, post the Squeeze (Acrobatics) roll. The move still happens; the GM reads the result.

movementLattice.name: Movement Lattice
movementLattice.hint: Choose continuous geometry or a fixed hex lattice at one tenth of a square. Normal hex routes use the full token footprint. A separate cramped-passage fallback runs only when no full-footprint route exists. Applies to the next preview.

floors.climbRefused: {name} cannot walk up {rise} ft (more than one {step} ft step). Use Climb or Fly.

gridless.debugCostLegend: Cost per CELL — White: normal · Amber: higher · Red: ×3+
gridless.absoluteElevationHint: Hold to show every token's scene elevation instead of its height above the floor below or relative to your selected token, and to read the floor height under the cursor.
gridless.previewMovementHint: Hold to preview remaining movement and ready attack distances for exactly one selected token on a gridless scene.
gridless.selectArea: Place this effect's area first. If it has multiple areas, select the one to use before rolling.
gridless.blocked: The target has no line of effect from the origin.
